login_confirm_prompt:
Sign in to ReMoodle Calendar?

Confirm only if you just pressed "Continue with Telegram" on {host} yourself. Anyone you share this link with could sign in as you.
login_confirmed: ✅ Signed in. Return to your browser.
login_expired: This sign-in link has expired. Start again in the browser.
my_du_intro: Connect your university account to get your class schedule, reminders, and the daily digest.
my_du_status_paused: Updates paused. Reconnect to resume; saved classes stay.
my_du_term_prompt: Which academic period should I import?
my_du_week_prompt:
Send the Monday of teaching week 1 for this period, for example 07.09.2026.

My DU only gives week numbers, so this date from your academic calendar puts each class on the right day.
my_du_week_invalid: That's not a Monday. Send a date like 07.09.2026.
my_du_sign_in_prompt:
1. Tap the button and sign in with your university Microsoft account.
2. My DU opens, maybe as a blank page. Copy its full address.
3. Send the address here within 10 minutes.

The address holds a one-time login code, so I delete your message right after reading it. Your password never reaches ReMoodle.
my_du_disconnect_prompt:
Disconnect My DU?

Automatic updates stop and your login is deleted. Saved classes stay.
